name: Pepper Zara Coupon
original_name: ペッパー・ザラ・クーポン
source: The princess of a foreign counry who lacks common sense but is very gentle. In order to become a bride, she decided to become one of the wife candidates herself. In fact, Pepper is always carrying around the marriage forms with her.
